pages.text: $(t2)Tier 2$() bosses live in the Twilight Forest, Blue Skies, and The Aether. This is where $(thing)Simply Swords$() uniques begin. Prepare in full steel or manasteel before attempting Twilight Forest.

$(bold)Naga$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Tempest$(/l), Naga Scale.$(br2)$(bold)Lich$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Soulrender$(/l), Lich Soul.$(br2)$(bold)Hydra$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Emberblade$(/l), Hydra Fang.$(br2)$(bold)Ur-Ghast$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Whisperwind$(/l) (20% — highest $(t2)T2$() rate), Ur-Ghast Tear.

$(bold)Knight Phantom$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Enigma$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Snow Queen$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Frostfall$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Alpha Yeti$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Icewhisper$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies Bosses$() — Summoner, Alchemist, Starlit Crusher, Arachnarch. Each drops a unique.$(br2)$(bold)Aether Bosses$() — Slider, Valkyrie Queen, Sun Spirit. Each drops a unique.
